|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">帝国のタイ・ファイターは、防御力こそ低いものの、速度と機動性に優れている。巧みな捨て身の戦法で、反乱軍のXウイングやYウイングの弱点を突く。</span><ref name="photo" />
|translation='''Title:''' Reckless Tactics<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Until the end of this turn, any starfighter gains maneuver +2 and power +1. If it has hyperspeed, it also gains hyperspeed +2. You may use this Interrupt immediately after a destiny targeting the starfighter is drawn to affect the result.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Imperial [[TIE Fighter|TIE fighters]] have low defensive strength but excellent speed and maneuverability. Skillful, self-sacrificing tactics exploit the weaknesses of Rebel [[X-wing|X-wings]] and [[Y-wing|Y-wings]].<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese and English preserve the same maneuver, power and conditional hyperspeed increases through the remainder of the turn. The Japanese parenthesis refers generally to a destiny targeting the starfighter; the English specifically says a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver. The Japanese lore describes self-sacrificing tactics, while the English calls the tactics sophisticated.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-darkmaneuvers.gif|Dark Maneuvers original English printed face]].</ref>
